standard_prerequisites.name: A pseudo-coherent complex can be represented by a bounded above complex of finite free modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the finite free complex E whose terms are the reductions of the complex to be built on the other side.

standard_prerequisites.name: A bounded above complex over the quotient with a lift of its terms can be lifted to a bounded above complex of projective modules with the prescribed reductions
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the complex P of projective modules lifting E, which is the candidate representing object on the other side.

standard_prerequisites.name: Nakayama's lemma lets one conclude that a projective module over the ring whose reduction to the quotient is finite free is itself finite free
standard_prerequisites.use: Upgrades the projectivity of the terms of P to finite freeness, which is what pseudo-coherence of the lifted object requires.

core_obligations: One direction is immediate from the pullback statement for pseudo-coherence, since K is the pullback of K' along the surjection (proof lines 19504-19505).
For the converse assume K pseudo-coherent and represent it by a bounded above complex of finite free modules over the quotient, using the representation statement (proof lines 19505-19507).

Lift that complex to a bounded above complex of projective modules over the ring with the prescribed reductions, using the lifting statement applied along the nilpotent surjection (proof lines 19507-19511).

Apply Nakayama's lemma to each lifted term to see that the projective modules are finite free, so the lifted complex is a bounded above complex of finite free modules representing K' and K' is pseudo-coherent (proof lines 19512-19514).
proof_roadmap: Dispose of the easy direction with the pullback statement (proof lines 19504-19505).
Represent the pseudo-coherent object by a finite free complex and lift it projectively (proof lines 19505-19511).
Make the lifted terms finite free with Nakayama and conclude (proof lines 19512-19514).
difficulty_reason: 证明 11 行，但反向那一半是实构造：把 K 换成有限自由有界上方复形，用「沿幂零核满射可把复形提升成投射模复形」得到 P，再用 Nakayama 把每个 P^n 变成有限自由，从而 K' 伪凝聚。三个步骤（表示、提升、Nakayama）都写在 span 内，属可收；3 处同章引用作桩。
